name: Dujella–Peral–Tadić · Z/6 · Rank 3 Families
description: Six explicit one-parameter Z/6Z families of exact generic rank 3 analyzed by Dujella, Peral and Tadić: Lecacheux, Kihara, two Eroshkin branches, Dujella–Peral, and MacLeod.
generic_rank_status: Dujella–Peral–Tadić prove exact generic rank 3 and full free generators for every included variant. Rank Hunter independently exact-certifies each published basis at the paper's injective control.

source.name: Andrej Dujella, High rank elliptic curves with prescribed torsion

auto_search.strategy_note: Prescribed-C6 rank hunt: exact specialized C6 torsion gate, exact published rank-3 baseline, then search for independent extras.

provenance.theorem_boundary: The paper applies the Gusić–Tadić specialization criterion and identifies exact rank 3 plus free generators for each included family. Rank Hunter independently reconstructs only the generic lower bound through exact specialized independence certificates.
